# Privacy Policy

**Last updated:** June 11, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Ripple ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your information when you use the Ripple mobile application.

---

## Information We Collect

### Information you provide
- **Email address** — used to create and authenticate your account
- **Display name** — the name you choose during profile setup
- **Avatar selection** — the avatar index you choose

### Information generated by your use of the app
- **Progress data** — your action completion count and level (Seed, Spark, Wave)
- **Notification preferences** — whether you've opted in to daily reminders and your preferred reminder time

### Information we do NOT collect
- We do not collect your location
- We do not collect contacts or address book data
- We do not access your camera or photos
- We do not collect any financial information

---

## How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

- Create and manage your account
- Sync your progress across devices
- Send daily reminder notifications (only if you opt in)
- Show your ripple count and level within the app

We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We do not use your information for advertising purposes.

---

## Third-Party Services

Ripple uses **Supabase** to store account data and profile information securely. Supabase processes data in accordance with their own [Privacy Policy](https://supabase.com/privacy).

No other third-party analytics or advertising SDKs are included in the app.

---

## Push Notifications

If you grant permission, Ripple may send you daily reminders to complete your kind action. You can disable notifications at any time in:

- The Ripple app under **Settings → Notifications**
- Your iPhone's **Settings → Notifications → Ripple**

---

## Data Retention

Your account data is retained for as long as your account is active. You may request deletion of your account and all associated data by contacting us at the email below. We will process deletion requests within 30 days.

---

## Children's Privacy

Ripple is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

---

## Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by updating the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

---

## Contact

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or want to request data deletion, contact us at:
